danger.title: Erase everything
danger.description: Deletes all your characters, campaigns, notes, library entries, packs and roll history. Your account and sign-in stay. This cannot be undone, so you have to confirm with your Google sign-in first.

wipeDialog.title: Erase everything in your account?
wipeDialog.description: Characters, campaigns, notes, library entries, packs and roll history are deleted permanently. Confirm with your Google sign-in ({{email}}) to continue.

toasts.wiped: Everything was deleted. Your account is still here.

assistant.metaDescription: Create and revoke keys that let an outside assistant work in your campaigns.
assistant.title: Assistant access
assistant.description: Give Claude a key so it can read your campaigns and add entries for you. It acts as you: game master work only in campaigns you run.
assistant.addressHint: Paste this address and your key into Claude when adding a new connection.
assistant.newKeyDescription: Copy it now — it is shown only once.
assistant.revokeDescription: Anything using this key stops working right away. You can create a new one at any time.
assistant.promptDescription: Copy a ready-made prompt and paste it into Claude so it learns how to connect and what it can do in your campaigns.
